LanguageData.Cinder_StorySettingsIntro: The -[占位符文本-Cinder_EmberWarden] alternates long respites with concentrated battles.
LanguageData.Cinder_CalmVeryShortPrompt: How much respite are you willing to give her?
LanguageData.Cinder_CalmSettingsHint: Each respite is sampled from this range. Equal values give a fixed duration. Changes apply to the next respite and preserve current progress.\n\nDefaults: 15–30 days and 6–10 battle waves. The first wave is attempted immediately when battle begins; later waves wait 3–12 hours after an encounter ends. Double waves have a 33% chance and use different factions. Cradle raids have a 25% selection chance when both Cradle and other factions are eligible, with fallback to an available faction otherwise. During respite, helpful events occur twice as often and colonists' random mood breaks are half as likely. Quest and player-triggered threats remain independent.
LanguageData.Cinder_BattleFallback: “They are coming. Prepare your defenses. We will survive together.”
LanguageData.Cinder_CalmFallback: “It is quiet for now. Take care of yourselves.”
LanguageData.Cinder_BattleDialogue:
“The wind has changed. Bring the strength you gathered while resting. It is time to protect our garden.”

This battle brings {0} major threats. Each encounter normally ends before the next begins, though two waves may arrive together.

I will wait for the final battle to end before bringing you peace.
LanguageData.Cinder_CalmDialogue:
“It is over. Put down your weapons and tend your wounds. The garden remains, and so do we.”

Your new respite lasts {0} days, with at most one random major threat.

Good fortune will visit more often, and weary minds will find it easier to endure. Use this time well.
